sources.title: Law nº 049/2023 of 05/09/2023 establishing the value added tax
sources.coverage: standard VAT rate 18% and zero rate (Article 4); zero-rated goods/services list (Article 7)
sources.notes: Published in Official Gazette n° Special of 14/09/2023, trilingual (Kinyarwanda/English/French). Repeals Law No 37/2012 of 09/11/2012. Downloaded directly from the Rwanda Revenue Authority (primary government source). Subsequently amended (Article 8 exemptions only) by Law nº 009/2025 of 27/05/2025 — see RWA-MININJUST-OG-2025-05-29 below.

sources.title: Official Gazette n° Special of 29/05/2025 — includes Law nº 011/2025 of 27/05/2025 establishing the excise duty, and Law nº 009/2025 of 27/05/2025 amending the VAT law
sources.coverage: excise duty imposition and Annex rate schedule (Law 011/2025); confirms VAT amendment (Law 009/2025) touches only Article 8 exemptions, not the rate articles
sources.notes: Law nº 011/2025 of 27/05/2025 repeals and replaces the prior excise duty law (Law nº 050/2023 of 05/09/2023). Its Annex lists ~27 excisable product/service categories with HS codes; only a representative subset was transcribed into excise_measures.json this cycle.
